what: owner execution directive: S1 path, 5 new workstreams, S1-readiness conditions, controls C5-C6

execution_directive_2026_09_27.objective: reach an executable S1 Hall-thruster qualification test, then LOCK-2, then the controlled HW-0 / HW-RF / HW-ECR experiment deciding thrust and sustainment
execution_directive_2026_09_27.chain: W1 + W2 + W3 + W4 + W5 -> owner review -> LOCK-1 -> S1 qualification -> measured uncertainty/calibration -> LOCK-2 -> score-bearing common-condition experiment
execution_directive_2026_09_27.data_rule: no experimental data is used for model promotion until the W5 pre-registration is frozen
execution_directive_2026_09_27.S1_purpose: qualification, not architecture selection: stand, feed system, H-1, cathode, power measurement, magnetic configuration and diagnostics reproducible enough for the paired test; Phase 1 locates the Hall-only N2 sustainment knee and characterizes ignition/extinction, which then places the RF/ECR comparisons
execution_directive_2026_09_27.LOCK2: freezes what only real facility performance can determine (achieved thrust and power uncertainty, repeatability, drift, block count if the preregistered rule allows it, calibration constants, facility corrections); S1 architecture-comparison outcomes never alter decision thresholds
execution_directive_2026_09_27.phase2: HW-0 <-> HW-RF <-> HW-ECR on the same H-1, C-1, feed condition, V_d, magnetic configuration, facility and diagnostics; measure at minimum thrust, complete P_bus, I_d, feed state, stability/oscillations, ignition/extinction, cathode state; discriminator R_arch; absolute feasibility judged separately
execution_directive_2026_09_27.phase3: absolute capability across the representative feed envelope: >= 12 mN sustained and the registered 25 mN capability under P_bus < 1.5 kW

new_workstreams.fo_ao_lifetime_register: Hall lifetime / atomic-oxygen degradation register and H-1 witness/coupon/diagnostic provisions
new_workstreams.fo_hallmap_schema_v2_registry: Hall-map schema v2 (wall-adjacent T_e, SEE model/yield, wall-impact species, incidence angle only where the solver genuinely supplies them) + immutable map registry
new_workstreams.fo_magnet_coil_qualification: H-1 magnet/coil qualification basis (actual candidate grades, insulation systems, conductors; MMPA/MIL generic values reference only)
new_workstreams.fo_s1_readiness_gate: explicit S1-readiness gate reporting S1_NOT_READY with missing items
new_workstreams.fo_repo_decisions_batch: low-cost repository decisions (pymsis to [msis] extra; golden CLI test stays in normal CI; ruleset only, 0 approvals, 3 contexts, branch current; S12 template decision hash empty)

S1_readiness_conditions: H-1/C-1 configuration frozen sufficiently for qualification
DI-1 or explicitly labelled ground-qualification feed points available

controls_added.C5_AO_early: W3, W4 and the AO/lifetime lane coordinate now: H-1 carries witness coupons, replaceable channel/anode components, cathode-exposure monitoring and post-test metrology provisions from the start (integration check before W3 is merged; targeted repair if absent)
controls_added.C6_no_extrapolation: no 15,000 h extrapolation from an unadmitted Hall closure

execution_directive_2026_09_27.management_rule: maximize parallel progress toward S1 readiness; non-gating analysis never delays the hardware path unless it changes a safety limit, experimental validity or a pre-registered decision condition
execution_directive_2026_09_27.reporting: SUPERSEDED by owner 2026-09-27: every update covers ALL workstreams (the 7 pivot lanes + the 5 execution-directive lanes) with their actual content, so the decision on thrust and subsystems can be taken from the full picture
